name: Ramdas Mujahirudin
original_name: ラムダス・ムジャヒルディーン
source:
He is a competent and strict butler who was given to him by an Indian maharajah who had been associated with the Turner family.

Although his son had already succeeded in business in India and was already living a wealthy life, the righteous man himself continued to serve the protagonist until his body was destroyed.

He has brought in a well-made granddaughter to take his place.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
